subject: Issues with incorporating variable transect lengths into tlength.

messages.author: 35dca3dfdd95d8d4
messages.subject: Issues with incorporating variable transect lengths into tlength.
parts:
Hello everyone,

I have distance sampling data that has been collected in an urbanized area, thus not allowing for equal transect lengths during each survey locations (i.e subject to road lengths, etc.). Currently I am working on modeling population dynamics, and working to incorporate temporary emigration/availability. My primary issue at this moment has to do with generating a unmarked GDS frame, in particular the argument tlength. Because each transect is of differing lengths, and not all sites were visited during each sampling occasion it's important that tlength reflects this. I am able to create a functional GDS frame if I use tlength=rep(an average of the differing lengths, nrow=(Y)), but this is only a mean and does not reflect sampling effort for each respective site during each occasion. If I try to read in the lengths directly using an object as i.e (tlength=object), it does not work. 

I have also created a factor argument using:
length <- as.matrix(read_excel("C:/Users/jcdil/Documents/AbundanceR2018/analysis/Length2016.xlsx", col_types = c("blank", rep("numeric", 19))))
lengths16 <- as.factor(lengths)

umf <- unmarkedFrameGDS(y = Y[,1:170], survey="line", unitsIn="m", tlength=(lengths16),
                        dist.breaks=c(0,20,40,60,80,100,120,140,160), numPrimary = 19,
                        siteCovs = data.frame(TREE, GRASS, WATER, SHRUB, IMPERV, LENGTH),
                        yearlySiteCovs=list(rep = rep, DATE = DATE, HOUR = HOUR))

This successfully generates a GDS frame, but when I start the modeling process with:

summary(fm0.exp <- gdistsamp(lambdaformula = ~1, phiformula = ~1, pformula = ~1,
                             keyfun = "exp", output = "density", unitsOut = "ha",
                             mixture = "P", K = 100, se = TRUE, data = umf) )

I get this respective error:

Error in optim(starts, nll, method = method, hessian = se, ...) : 
  initial value in 'vmmin' is not finite

I have searched this group, as well as countless other forums, groups, etc. and I am unable to find a way to successfully incorporate the differing transect lengths to the argument of tlength. I've also tried different starting values as well, to no avail. Is anyone aware of a way in which I can successfully circumnavigate this or fix this issue? Thank you so much for any assistance you may provide me with! If any other samples of my code as necessary, please let me know and I can happily provide them.

Thanks again,
Jacob Dillon
